title: 5 Days 5 Marathon OWS: Set 2 (Q26 to Q50)
subtitle: Avalanche to Album

words.hindi: हिमस्खलन (पहाड़ से तेज़ी से गिरती बर्फ और चट्टानों का ढेर)
words.meaning: A mass of snow, ice, and rocks falling rapidly down a mountainside.
words.example: The sudden avalanche buried the mountain highway under thick snow.

words.hindi: व्याख्या या स्पष्टता के लिए जोड़ी गई संक्षिप्त टिप्पणी
words.meaning: A brief note or explanation added alongside a text to provide clarity or context.
words.example: She added a helpful annotation next to the difficult paragraph.

words.hindi: मिश्रण या व्यंजन का एक भाग (अवयव)
words.meaning: A part or element of a mixture or compound.
words.example: Flour, sugar, and eggs are the basic ingredients of a cake.

words.hindi: खुदरा विक्रेता (जनता को सीधे सामान बेचने वाले)
words.meaning: People or businesses who sell goods directly to the public.
words.example: Local retailers offered heavy discounts during the festive season.

words.hindi: पत्नी से बहुत अधिक प्रेम करने वाला
words.meaning: One who is excessively fond of or devoted to one's wife.
words.example: He is an uxorious husband who always prioritizes his wife's happiness.

words.hindi: बहुत अधिक अव्यवस्था, भ्रम या भँवर की स्थिति
words.meaning: A situation of great confusion, turmoil, and disorder.
words.example: The small fishing boat was caught in a dangerous maelstrom.

words.hindi: जहाज़ चलाने वाला (कर्णधार)
words.meaning: A person who steers a ship or boat.
words.example: The skilled helmsman steered the ship safely through the storm.

words.hindi: प्रस्तावना (उपन्यास या रचना का शुरुआती भाग)
words.meaning: A piece of writing that introduces a novel, book, or play.
words.example: The prologue gives essential background information before the story begins.

words.hindi: सर्वेश्वरवादी (ईश्वर और ब्रह्मांड को एक मानने वाला)
words.meaning: A person who believes that God and the universe are the same.
words.example: A pantheist sees the presence of God in every part of nature.

words.hindi: डर, घबराहट या आशंका
words.meaning: A feeling of fear, anxiety, or apprehension in tense situations.
words.example: She stepped into the dark room with a feeling of trepidation.

words.hindi: अवर्णनीय (जिसे शब्दों में न बताया जा सके)
words.meaning: Too great or extreme to be expressed or described in words.
words.example: The beauty of the Himalayan sunrise was truly ineffable.

words.hindi: भंडारण या परिवहन के लिए बाँधा गया बड़ा गट्ठा
words.meaning: A large bundle bound tightly for storage or transportation.
words.example: The farmer carried a heavy bale of hay to the barn.

words.hindi: आत्मनिरीक्षण करना (अपने विचारों और इरादों की जाँच करना)
words.meaning: To examine one's own thoughts, feelings, and motives.
words.example: He sat quietly in the evening to introspect on his exam preparation.

words.hindi: गमले में कलात्मक ढंग से उगाया गया बौना (छोटा) पेड़
words.meaning: Dwarfed varieties of trees and shrubs grown artistically in pots.
words.example: She kept a miniature banyan bonsai on her study desk.

words.hindi: प्राणी विज्ञान (जानवरों का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन)
words.meaning: The scientific study of the behaviour, structure, physiology, classification, and distribution of animals.
words.example: She is pursuing a bachelor's degree in zoology.

words.hindi: अदाह्य (जो आग न पकड़ सके या जल न सके)
words.meaning: Incapable of catching fire or burning.
words.example: Glass and asbestos are incombustible materials.

words.hindi: आत्ममुग्ध (खुद को अत्यधिक महत्व और प्रशंसा देने वाला)
words.meaning: Someone who exhibits excessive self-importance and admiration for oneself.
words.example: He is a narcissist who admires himself in the mirror all day.

words.hindi: ढोंगी / पाखंडी (ज्ञान या कौशल का झूठा दिखावा करने वाला)
words.meaning: One who falsely pretends to have special knowledge or skills.
words.example: The fake healer turned out to be a charlatan fooling innocent people.

words.hindi: खुली या भीड़भाड़ वाली जगहों से डर
words.meaning: Extreme or irrational fear of open or public spaces.
words.example: He suffers from agoraphobia and feels anxious in wide open grounds.

words.hindi: बहरा (सुनने में असमर्थ)
words.meaning: One who cannot hear; lacking the power of hearing.
words.example: The old man is deaf and uses a hearing aid.

words.hindi: दुर्भावनापूर्ण (दूसरों को नुकसान या बुराई पहुँचाने की इच्छा रखने वाला)
words.meaning: Having or showing a wish to do evil or cause harm to others.
words.example: Everyone stayed away from him because of his malevolent intentions.

words.hindi: हमनाम (समान नाम वाला व्यक्ति)
words.meaning: A person having the same name as another.
words.example: The young boy is his grandfather's namesake.

words.hindi: अँधेरे से डर
words.meaning: An extreme or irrational fear of darkness or the night.
words.example: Because of nyctophobia, she always sleeps with a night lamp on.

words.hindi: भेड़ या बकरी की आवाज़ (मिमियाना)
words.meaning: The weak, wavering cry or sound made by a sheep, goat, or calf.
words.example: The sheep bleats loudly in the green meadow.

words.hindi: फ़ोटो, टिकट या चित्र रखने की पुस्तक
words.meaning: A blank book for keeping a collection of photographs, stamps, or pictures.
words.example: We looked through our old family photo album during the holidays.
